questions.question: A. Case Study: Home Link Connect Pvt. Ltd. (Compulsory) In 2013, three college friends - Aarav Nair , Meera Sethi , and Dev Chaudhary launched Home Link Connect in Bangalore after first -hand frustration with paying 1–2 months’ rent in brokerage to house -hunting agents. They turned this recurring pain point into a tech -enabled consumer-to-consumer (C2C) platform where tenants and landlords could list and connect directly. Using AI-based ranking , listings were sorted according to commute time, liveability metrics, and price trends, eliminating the need for brokers. Within six months of piloting in Bengaluru, Home Link received over 35,000 user signups , validating demand and enabling the refinements recommended via their Lean Canvas model. Their early success attracted major investors like Tiger Global, General Atlantic, and Moore Strategic Ventures, resulting in a $210 million Series E funding round in —valuing Home Link at $1.01 billion and making it India's first prop-tech unicorn. By 2023, Home Link had scaled to six major cities (Bengaluru, Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai), facilitated over 500,000 transactions per year, and offered value-add services - leasing legal support, packing/movers, tenant insurance, and society-management tools—under its fast-growing Home Link Hood App, deployed in over 10,000 housing communities Despite facing hostility from local broker associations —including an incident where agents attacked their office in 2015 - Home Link reinforced trust and reputation via a “Say No to Brokerage” campaign, verified listings, responsive legal support, and high service standards . Today, the company stands as a textbook example of how environmental scanning , lean prototyping, systematic planning, legal incorporation, and branding can come together to build a disruptive, sustainable startup platform. • Summarise the three key elements of the business opportunity that Home Link founders identified before launching. • Explain how Aarav, Meera, and Dev used environmental scanning to confirm the opportunity across Bangalore, analyze the rental market inefficiencies, and frame their digital model. • Summarise the main sections of their business plan and how each contributed to investor confidence. • Identify two types of feasibility study they likely conducted and explain one insight each gave at an early stage.
